A '''base''' was established on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talasea]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. It was [[Raid on Talasea|attacked]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and subsequently abandoned.
